sshhelp.title: How do I get a key?
sshhelp.one: Each computer takes its own key, so this key's file is named {{file}}.
sshhelp.make.title: Make one here
sshhelp.make.body: Your browser makes the key, and nothing is sent until you use it. You download the private half once; this page never keeps it and never sends it. A key made here has no passphrase: for one, use the terminal steps below.
sshhelp.make.unsupported: This browser can't make SSH keys. Use the terminal steps below.
sshhelp.made.body: Download the private key now. It can be downloaded once only: if you lose it, make a new one.
sshhelp.saved.body: {{file}} went to your browser's downloads. This page no longer has it.
sshhelp.saved.again: Didn't get the file? Make a new key
sshhelp.saved.notYet: This key isn't in use yet: nothing was sent.
sshhelp.saved.notYetOn: This key isn't on {{computer}} yet: nothing was sent.
sshhelp.saved.useSet: Use this key on this computer
sshhelp.saved.used: The public key is in the field above.
sshhelp.move.windows: Move it from Downloads into your .ssh folder
sshhelp.move.mac: Move it from Downloads into your .ssh folder, readable by you only
sshhelp.move.linux: Move it from Downloads into your .ssh folder, readable by you only
sshhelp.moveElsewhere: If your browser saves downloads to another folder, or renamed the file (for example with (1) added), change the first path to match, inside the quotes. The key still lands under the name shown.
sshhelp.term.title: Or use a terminal
sshhelp.intro.windows: Open PowerShell. If it says ssh-keygen isn't recognized, add OpenSSH Client under Settings > System > Optional features.
sshhelp.folder: Make the folder for keys (nothing changes if it exists)
sshhelp.passphrase: It asks for a passphrase: setting one protects the key if the file is ever copied. If it says the file already exists, answer n and change the file name in every command here.
sshhelp.copy.linux: Show the public key, then copy the whole line
sshhelp.where: {{file}}.pub is the public half: that is the one to paste.
sshhelp.private: {{file}}, without .pub, is your private key. Keep it on your machine and never paste it anywhere, here included.
sshhelp.config: To connect with just ssh and the address, add these lines to your SSH config file ({{path}})
sshhelp.connectLater: Once the key is saved, the Connect tab shows the command to connect.
sshhelp.made.notSaved: The download didn't start, and the key is gone from this page. Make a new one.
